name: Three-Body Problem and Libration-Point Orbits
summary: The circular restricted three-body problem, Lagrange points, halo orbits and the low-energy transfers used by modern lunar and astronomy missions.

topics.name: Circular restricted three-body problem (CR3BP) equations in the rotating frame
Periodic orbits: Lyapunov, halo and vertical orbits
Invariant manifolds and the Interplanetary Superhighway
Near-rectilinear halo orbits (Gateway) and distant retrograde orbits
Low-energy lunar transfers and weak-stability-boundary transfers
Ephemeris models and transition to real missions (JWST, SOHO)
